t: Listen to the following announcement in a classroom.
Hey everyone, quick heads up about how we're going to grade the group projects this semester.
Instead of one grade for the whole group, each of you will get your own grade based on what you contribute to the project.
This change is because we've noticed that not everyone contributes equally, and I believe this way is fairer to all.
If you have questions about this or need more details on how contributions are assessed, please come see me after class.
